description: Implied probability of one market as the last value per bucket, for any range (default the last 24 hours at 5 minute resolution). History is kept permanently, including for closed markets. Without a PRO plan, the full series costs $0.002 per call from the caller's prepaid credit; callers without credit get the latest 12 points.

from.description: Start, ISO-8601 instant or epoch millis (default: 24h before 'to')

to.description: End, exclusive, ISO-8601 instant or epoch millis (default: now)
